rows.heading: The Backstage Guy
rows.body: From designing shows to managing them, from creating visuals to running them live, the music industry has always been my favorite place to work. Forty-plus shows in the last four years and I'm still counting.

rows.heading: The tour manager
rows.body: Vans, visas, load-ins, day sheets. If the show starts on time and everyone's fed and accounted for, I did the job right.

rows.heading: On two wheels & two feet
rows.body: Long rides and longer runs are where the actual thinking happens. Half the ideas on this site were worked out somewhere around km 20.

rows.heading: In the friend circle
rows.body: The designated planner, driver and photo-taker. Someone has to book the table, keep the plan alive, and remember where we left the car.

rows.heading: Introvert / extrovert
rows.body: Loud in a room of six, invisible in a room of sixty. Both are me — just on different days, and I've stopped apologising for either.
